2026-07-31T16:18:18.3582408Z     ### Batch Execution
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3582620Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3583086Z     Execute multiple browser actions in a single request with optimized response handling and flexible error control.
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3583685Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3583904Z     #### Basic Batch Execution

2026-07-31T16:18:18.3602993Z     #### Error Handling Options
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3603223Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3603583Z     - **`continueOnError`** (per step): Continue batch execution even if this step fails
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3604100Z     - **`stopOnFirstError`** (global): Stop entire batch on first error
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3604551Z     - Flexible combination allows for robust automation workflows
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3604881Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3605099Z     ### Tool-Specific Defaults
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3605334Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3605641Z     Each tool has optimized defaults based on typical usage patterns:
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3605979Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3606323Z     - **Navigation tools** (`browser_navigate`): Include full context for verification
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3606906Z     - **Interactive tools** (`browser_click`, `browser_type`): Include snapshot but minimal logging
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3607413Z     - **Screenshot/snapshot tools**: Exclude additional context
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3607856Z     - **Code evaluation**: Include console output but minimal other info
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3608337Z     - **Wait operations**: Minimal output for efficiency
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3608862Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3609155Z     ### Performance Benefits
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3609507Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3609872Z     - **Token Reduction**: 50-80% reduction in token usage with optimized expectations
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3610542Z     - **Faster Execution**: 2-5x speed improvement with batch execution
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3611008Z     - **Reduced Latency**: Fewer round trips between client and server
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3611482Z     - **Cost Optimization**: Lower API costs due to reduced token consumption
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3611840Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3612058Z     ### Response Diff Detection
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3612296Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3612779Z     The Fast Server includes automatic diff detection to efficiently track changes between consecutive tool executions:
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3613259Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3613455Z     ```json
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3613647Z     {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3613876Z       \"name\": \"browser_click\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3614137Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3614403Z         \"element\": \"Load more button\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3614705Z         \"ref\": \"#load-more\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3614956Z         \"expectation\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3615220Z           \"includeSnapshot\": true,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3615564Z           \"diffOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3615832Z             \"enabled\": true,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3616112Z             \"threshold\": 0.1,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3616389Z             \"format\": \"unified\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3616683Z             \"maxDiffLines\": 50,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3616947Z             \"context\": 3
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3617191Z           }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3617392Z         }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3617591Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3617790Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3617986Z     ```
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3618173Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3618403Z     #### Diff Detection Benefits
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3618817Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3619208Z     - **Minimal token usage**: Only changed content is shown instead of full snapshots
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3619731Z     - **Change tracking**: Automatically detects what changed after actions
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3620244Z     - **Flexible formats**: Choose between unified, split, or minimal diff formats
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3620964Z     - **Smart caching**: Compares against previous response from the same tool
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3621331Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3621551Z     #### When to Use Diff Detection
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3621797Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3622128Z     1. **UI interactions without navigation**: Clicks, typing, hover effects
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3622614Z     2. **Dynamic content updates**: Loading more items, real-time updates
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3623057Z     3. **Form interactions**: Track changes as users fill forms
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3623519Z     4. **Selective monitoring**: Use with CSS selectors to track specific areas
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3623872Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3624065Z     ```json
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3624256Z     {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3624477Z       \"name\": \"browser_type\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3624730Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3624986Z         \"element\": \"Search input\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3625261Z         \"ref\": \"#search\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3625536Z         \"text\": \"playwright\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3625792Z         \"expectation\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3626057Z           \"includeSnapshot\": true,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3626349Z           \"snapshotOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3626640Z             \"selector\": \"#search-results\"
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3626916Z           },
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3627123Z           \"diffOptions\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3627379Z             \"enabled\": true,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3627648Z             \"format\": \"minimal\"
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3627889Z           }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3628077Z         }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3628262Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3628443Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3628635Z     ```
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3629050Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3629251Z     ### Best Practices
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3629465Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3629731Z     1. **Use batch execution** for multi-step workflows
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3630140Z     2. **Enable diff detection** for actions without page navigation
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3630715Z     3. **Disable snapshots** for intermediate steps that don't need verification
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3631197Z     4. **Use selective snapshots** with CSS selectors for large pages
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3631611Z     5. **Filter console messages** to relevant levels only
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3632085Z     6. **Combine global and step-specific expectations** for fine-grained control
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3632544Z     7. **Use minimal diff format** for maximum token savings
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3632842Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3633066Z     ### Diagnostic System Examples

2026-07-31T16:18:18.3642211Z     ### Network Request Filtering
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3642442Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3643004Z     The `browser_network_requests` tool provides advanced filtering capabilities to reduce token usage by up to 80-95% when working with network logs.
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3643538Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3643730Z     #### Basic Usage Examples
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3643953Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3644129Z     ```json
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3644358Z     // Filter API requests only
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3644590Z     {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3644819Z       \"name\": \"browser_network_requests\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3645096Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3645362Z         \"urlPatterns\": [\"api/\", \"/graphql\"]
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3645636Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3645808Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3645979Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3646189Z     // Exclude analytics and tracking
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3646430Z     {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3646666Z       \"name\": \"browser_network_requests\", 
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3646932Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3647258Z         \"excludeUrlPatterns\": [\"analytics\", \"tracking\", \"ads\"]
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3647579Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3647754Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3647937Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3648128Z     // Success responses only
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3648352Z     {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3648576Z       \"name\": \"browser_network_requests\",
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3648995Z       \"arguments\": {
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3649293Z         \"statusRanges\": [{ \"min\": 200, \"max\": 299 }]
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3649577Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3649797Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3650064Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3650255Z     // Recent errors only

2026-07-31T16:18:18.3651563Z         \"maxRequests\": 5,
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3651814Z         \"newestFirst\": true
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3652036Z       }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3652215Z     }
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3652391Z     ```

2026-07-31T16:18:18.3658875Z     #### Token Optimization Benefits
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3658968Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3659196Z     - **Massive reduction**: 80-95% fewer tokens for large applications
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3659377Z     - **Focused debugging**: See only relevant network activity
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3659614Z     - **Performance monitoring**: Track specific endpoints or error patterns
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3659815Z     - **Cost savings**: Lower API costs due to reduced token usage
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3659896Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660026Z     #### When to Use Network Filtering
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660114Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660297Z     1. **API debugging**: Focus on specific endpoints and methods
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660464Z     2. **Error monitoring**: Track only failed requests
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660684Z     3. **Performance analysis**: Monitor slow or problematic endpoints  
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3660866Z     4. **Large applications**: Reduce overwhelming network logs
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661042Z     5. **Token management**: Stay within LLM context limits
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661133Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661300Z     ### Migration Guide
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661391Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661595Z     Existing code continues to work without changes. To optimize:
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661674Z     
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3661934Z     1. Start by adding `expectation: { includeSnapshot: false }` to intermediate steps
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3662109Z     2. Use batch execution for sequences of 3+ operations
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3662313Z     3. Gradually fine-tune expectations based on your specific needs
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3662517Z     4. Use diagnostic tools when automation fails or needs debugging
2026-07-31T16:18:18.3662885Z     5. Set `--tool-profile=full` before upgrading when a client depends on the complete static `tools/list` response.
